units.source_text: 外国客人脸上仍然挂着微笑，但也看得出来颇有犹豫，

en.t: The foreign guest still had a smile on his face, but it was clear that he was rather hesitant,

units.source_text: 过了一会儿，他又伸出四根手指，又说了几句外国话。

en.t: After a while, he held up four fingers again and said a few more words in a foreign language.

units.source_text: 金花无可奈何的托着脸颊，一点也笑不出来了，

en.t: Jinhua helplessly propped her cheek in her hand and could not smile at all anymore,

units.source_text: 但想到事情已经这样了，自己也只能不停的摇头，让对方彻底死心。

en.t: but since things had already come to this, all she could do was keep shaking her head so that he would give up completely.

units.source_text: 但是，好像有什么看不见的东西抓住了客人的手一样，

en.t: But it was as if something invisible had seized the guest's hand,

units.source_text: 他再次伸出了五根手指。

en.t: he held out five fingers once again.
